description: Watch the trailer for Static Dread: The Submarine, an upcoming psychological PSX horror game. In Static Dread: The Submarine, you are at the heart of a Lovecraftian apocalypse aboard a nuclear submarine. Forge a path through the trackless chaos of a rising era, navigating a graveyard of fallen ships and unknown terrors with only the ghostly echoes of your sonar to guide you home. Your crew is losing their minds, and the situation is worsened by mysterious algae that have appeared, turning hosts into seaweed zombies. You are the First Mate. author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Echo Weaver trailer for this upcoming time-loop metroidbrainia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. The new Echo Weaver trailer showcases gameplay and a release date. Echo Weaver will be available on Xbox, Game Pass, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Epic Games Store, GOG, and Steam) on October 8, 2026.

You play as the last of the Weavers, waking up with no memory in the glitching, ruined utopia of Provenance. Every time the clock runs out, the world resets. But here is the twist: your character can already do everything required to beat the game—you just don't know how to do it yet. By exploring stunning biomes, interacting with bizarre survivors (like a sentient corporate AI cat), and unearthing hidden Echo Rifts, you will piece together the mechanics needed to rewrite the timeline.
title: Echo Weaver - Official Release Date Trailer
